exposure: Automated Insulin Delivery (AID) systems (Omnipod 5, Control-IQ, DIY Loop)
cohort: The study included six pregnant women with type 1 diabetes.
finding: Automated Insulin Delivery systems can achieve near-desired glycaemic targets with minimal hypoglycaemia in pregnant women with type 1 diabetes.
mod_finding: Four of the six patients had uncomplicated vaginal deliveries in their third trimester.
